description: Land Title Settlement Department - Katiyawa, Thalawa D/S Division, Anuradhapura District - Cad. Map No. 110108 (23/0597)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including parcel numbers, ownership details, extent of land, and legal encumbrances. The content is focused on land registration and property ownership matters, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4). There are no government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories that would take precedence over this land-focused content.
